title: Match protection to the affected group

blocks.heading: Match protection to the affected group
blocks.text: Evaluate protection by identifying who faces which risk, how a measure addresses it and what implementation costs or limits remain. Product claims concern consumers; disclosure and financial agreements concern capital providers. One business can require both protections, and a measure useful for one risk may leave another untouched. Information can improve choice, while persistent deceptive conduct may require investigation and enforcement. The discussion is conceptual rather than a judgement about a current legal case.

blocks.heading: Putting the idea to work
blocks.text: Fictional Tula Goods misstates a product feature to buyers and separately supplies unreliable accounts to a lender. Correct product information addresses buyers; verified financial disclosure addresses the lender. Prefer proportionate investigation and follow-up on both issues rather than a publicity slogan alone, while recognising administrative cost and residual business risk.

blocks.heading: Worked practice: Consumers, capital providers and protection
blocks.text:
Fictional Hela Goods makes a misleading product claim and supplies inaccurate accounts when seeking a loan. A consumer group can publish a checked comparison. A hypothetical regulator can investigate the claims and reporting. Management proposes a general trust-us poster instead.

a(i) State two mechanisms protecting consumers. [2]
a(ii) State two criteria for evaluating a protection measure. [2]
b State two interests consumers need protected when buying. [2]
c Explain why Hela’s lender needs truthful accounts rather than a physical security guard. [6]
d Evaluate verified correction and investigation against the poster alone. [8]

a(i) Accurate product information and a credible complaint route. a(ii) Whether it addresses the stated risk and whether it is implemented. b Safe suitable products and truthful claims. c Accounts support assessment of repayment cash, debts and risk; a guard protects premises but does not verify the borrower’s position or establish collateral rights. d A checked correction and investigation target the two forms of misleading information. The poster communicates reassurance without supplying missing evidence. Prefer the targeted response, while recognising its cost and that truthful records still do not guarantee repayment.
